operations.old:
Java/summon minecraft:axolotl ~ ~ ~Summons an axolotl at your position. Java — blue/summon minecraft:axolotl ~ ~ ~ {Variant:4}Current Java 26.x command tools use the blue variant value 4. Bedrock/summon axolotl ~ ~ ~Summons a normally generated axolotl. Bedrock — blue baby/summon axolotl ~ ~ ~ 0 0 minecraft:entity_bornUses the vanilla minecraft:entity_born event; current behavior data adds the blue variant when the summoned baby has no inherited variant.

Command data formats are more version-sensitive than survival mechanics. If a future Java release changes entity NBT or Bedrock command overloads, use the command suggestions for your installed version rather than copying syntax from an old guide.
operations.new:
Java/summon minecraft:axolotl ~ ~ ~Summons an axolotl at your position. Java — blue/summon minecraft:axolotl ~ ~ ~ {Variant:4}On current Java 26.x builds, variant value 4 is the blue axolotl. Bedrock/summon axolotl ~ ~ ~Summons a normally generated axolotl.

What about a blue-axolotl command in Bedrock? Older guides commonly recommend /summon axolotl ~ ~ ~ minecraft:entity_born. Current Microsoft behavior documentation defines minecraft:entity_born as the event used when an axolotl is produced through breeding, not as a documented stable blue-variant selector. Because Bedrock spawn-event behavior is version-sensitive, we do not present that older shortcut as a guaranteed current blue command. For a reliable blue axolotl in normal Bedrock gameplay, use breeding; for commands, use the suggestions exposed by your installed version.

Command data formats are more version-sensitive than survival mechanics. Java's Variant:4 syntax remains in current 26.x command references, but recheck command syntax after major technical updates.
